Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰 성공에 이어 새로운 의뢰를 가져오자, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 쉬엄쉬엄 하라는 잔소리를 했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After we successfully completed a quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nagged me not to overdo it when I accepted a new one.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 次から次へと依頼を持ってくる私を見て、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、根を詰めすぎるなと小言を言ってきた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 由于一完成委托后又带回了新的委托，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>便开始唠叨着要我别太勉强自己。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 由於一完成委託後又帶回了新的委託，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>便開始嘮叨著要我別太勉強自己。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir réussi la commission et avoir apporté une nouvelle, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> m'a dit de me reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem der Auftrag erfolgreich abgeschlossen und ein neuer hereingebracht wurde, nörgelte <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, ich solle es ruhig angehen lassen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de completar el encargo y traer uno nuevo, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me regañó para que me lo tomara con calma.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de concluir a missão e trazer uma nova, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me deu um puxão de orelha para pegar leve.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากทำภารกิจสำเร็จแล้ว ให้นำภารกิจใหม่มา <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็เริ่มบ่นว่าให้ฉันพักผ่อนบ้าง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi dan membawa misi baru, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengomeliku untuk santai saja.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi hoàn thành nhiệm vụ và nhận được một nhiệm vụ mới, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã cằn nhằn tôi hãy nghỉ ngơi đi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक कमीशन सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करने और एक नया लाने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने मुझे आराम करने की ताकीद की।
